networks.name: inspector
networks.description: Checks open agentic websites against the Worldwide Agentic Web MVP specification and explains how to fix each finding.
sample_queries: Inspect the broken sample and tell me what to fix first.
What does rule AW-H02 mean, and how do I fix it on GitHub Pages?
Write the agent-manifest.json fix for every manifest finding in the last report.
Which spec rules cover peer networks?
Can you log in to my hosting account and change the headers for me?

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions only. Inspections read other sites' public files only after the visitor confirms.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
